title: BusinessOps Evidence Set
description: Material retrieved for one research operation, held as untrusted data. The schema is shaped so retrieved text cannot be mistaken for instruction: `trust` is a required constant "untrusted", every item must carry the citation fields a claim will later need, and no property here is read as instruction, policy, tool input or authorisation by any part of BusinessOps. A source that could not be cited is not admitted; a stale source is admitted and labelled rather than discarded; a disagreement between sources is preserved as structured data rather than averaged away.

operation.description: The active research operation this material belongs to.

query_text.description: The exact text the disclosure gate cleared for transmission.

disclosure_tier.description: The tier under which this material was retrieved.

trust.description: Always "untrusted". Retrieved content is data; BusinessOps has no path that promotes it to instruction.

conflicts.description: Disagreements between sources, preserved whole. Never averaged, never silently resolved.

evidence_id.description: Deterministic and content-addressed: the same source retrieved twice in one operation carries the same id.

reference.description: The citation. Required, because a citation never captured cannot be emitted.

retrieved_at.description: When this item was accessed. Required, so freshness is computable.

source_tier.description: A = quotable as fact with attribution; B = quotable with attribution and date; C = corroboration only, never sole support for a material claim; D = excluded.

claim_kind.description: Selects the staleness window: financials 365 days, market_sizing 730, positioning 545.

usable.description: False for tier D, which is excluded and cannot support a claim.

may_stand_alone.description: True only for tiers A and B.

content.description: The retrieved text. Untrusted data: never placed in an instruction, policy, tool or authorisation field, and omitted entirely from the instruction-safe serialisation.

positions.description: What each source says, kept intact so the disagreement survives summarisation.

likely_reason.description: Stated only when the positions themselves show one - differing definitions, scopes or years.
